limitations: Image QA is visual, not metric validation. The measured/modelled scene and fit proofs are the geometry authority.
Generated material grain, fine silhouettes/hardware, lighting and exterior window scenery are representative.
Cat-tree full branch reach, lamp U-base, closet interior, actual door swings and tight installation clearances retain model-report field checks.
